meta.name: Form Identity Design System
meta.description: Constraint-driven branding system. 16 Brand Types × 4 colour options = 64 pre-validated identities.

OCLD.character: Outward energy. Concrete deliverables. Logic-driven decisions. Defined structure.
OCLD.colour_direction: Warm, active, trustworthy. Colours that open doors.

OCRD.name: The Connector
OCRD.character: Outward energy. Concrete deliverables. Relationship-led. Defined structure.
OCRD.colour_direction: Warm, social, approachable. Colours that invite.

OCLF.name: The Maker
OCLF.character: Outward energy. Concrete deliverables. Logic-driven. Fluid structure.
OCLF.colour_direction: Warm, energetic, hands-on. Colours that suggest momentum.

OCRF.name: The Host
OCRF.character: Outward energy. Concrete deliverables. Relationship-led. Fluid structure.
OCRF.colour_direction: Warm, welcoming, celebratory. Colours that gather people.

OALD.name: The Strategist
OALD.character: Outward energy. Conceptual value. Logic-driven. Defined structure.
OALD.colour_direction: Bold, intelligent, forward-facing. Colours that signal vision.

OARD.name: The Guide
OARD.character: Outward energy. Conceptual value. Relationship-led. Defined structure.
OARD.colour_direction: Warm, aspirational, guiding. Colours that inspire movement.

OALF.name: The Catalyst
OALF.character: Outward energy. Conceptual value. Logic-driven. Fluid structure.
OALF.colour_direction: Dynamic, provocative, energetic. Colours that disrupt.

OARF.name: The Advocate

OARF.colour_direction: Passionate, human, expressive. Colours that move people.

ICLD.name: The Expert
ICLD.character: Inward energy. Concrete deliverables. Logic-driven decisions. Defined structure.
ICLD.extended: Form Identity communicates through depth and precision — not volume. The work speaks before the brand does.
ICLD.colour_direction: Cool, dark, muted, minimal. Colours that signal mastery without announcement.

colour_logic.E_inward: Cool palette, low saturation. No warm-dominant hues.
colour_logic.S_concrete: Depth over lightness. Grounded, real tones that signal something has been made.
colour_logic.O_logic: Precise, unsentimental. Colours that communicate competence before warmth.
colour_logic.T_defined: Controlled range. One primary, tightly bounded. Nothing added without reason.

ICRD.name: The Craftsperson
ICRD.character: Inward energy. Concrete deliverables. Relationship-led. Defined structure.
ICRD.colour_direction: Cool but warm-accented. Colours that show care in the making.

ICLF.name: The Artisan
ICLF.character: Inward energy. Concrete deliverables. Logic-driven. Fluid structure.
ICLF.colour_direction: Precise but organic. Colours of the studio and workshop.

ICRF.name: The Companion
ICRF.character: Inward energy. Concrete deliverables. Relationship-led. Fluid structure.
ICRF.colour_direction: Natural, personal, careful. Colours that show presence.

IALD.name: The Philosopher

IALD.colour_direction: Austere, precise, intellectual. Colours of the library and laboratory.

IARD.name: The Counsellor
IARD.character: Inward energy. Conceptual value. Relationship-led. Defined structure.
IARD.colour_direction: Calm, considered, trustworthy. Colours that hold space.

IALF.name: The Visionary
IALF.character: Inward energy. Conceptual value. Logic-driven. Fluid structure.
IALF.colour_direction: Spare, unexpected, singular. Colours that arrive fully formed.

IARF.name: The Poet
IARF.character: Inward energy. Conceptual value. Relationship-led. Fluid structure.
IARF.colour_direction: Soft, layered, intimate. Colours of the inner world made visible.

options.name: Forest
options.why: The deepest green in the system. Conveys craft, quiet authority, and precision without announcing itself.

options.name: Midnight
options.why: Deep navy built for maximum trust at maximum contrast. Institutional weight without institutional coldness.

options.name: Slate
options.why: Blue-grey that sits between navy and graphite. Disappears into the system; the work leads.

options.name: Deep Teal
options.why: The most singular option. Occupies a space almost no small business brand claims.

selected.name: Graphite
selected.why: Near-black cool — stripped to expertise, nothing decorative.
selected.override_note: Client selection. Outside original 4 ICLD options — chosen for maximum neutrality.

typography.scale_note: √2 — each step is 41.4% larger than the previous

A4.formula: Body size (12px) = col gutter. Line height (19px) = row gutter. Field = 6 lines × 19px ≈ 121px.

_meta.formula: All values derived from Müller-Brockmann. Body size → line height → field height → row gutter → column gutter → margins.

a3_poster_portrait.name: A3 Poster Portrait
a3_poster_portrait.type_rule: Display+H1 dominant. Body only in narrow text panels.

layout_rules.hero_zone: cols 1-4, rows 1-2 (full bleed image or primary headline)
layout_rules.image_zone: cols 1-4, rows 1-3 (60-80% of surface per Müller-Brockmann)
layout_rules.rule: One element occupies 60-80% of surface. Everything else is subordinate.

a3_poster_portrait.notes: Field 152px = 8 lines × 19px. Müller-Brockmann used A3 for dominant-image layouts.

certificate_a3_landscape.name: Certificate A3 Landscape

layout_rules.rule: Centred hierarchy. Formal, open spacing. No body below row 4.

certificate_a3_landscape.notes: Same column count as A4 despite wider format — wider columns produce formal spacing appropriate to a certificate.

compliments_slip_dl.name: Compliments Slip DL
compliments_slip_dl.type_rule: H3 (company name), Body (single message line), Caption (contact details).

layout_rules.rule: Logo anchors top-left. Contact anchors right. Message fills centre-left.

compliments_slip_dl.notes: Same width as A4 — inherits A4 column spec. Row gutter uses 10pt/16px (Cluster B) as this is brief-read at close distance. Col gutter uses Cluster A (19px) for A4 width consistency.

envelope_dl.name: Envelope DL
envelope_dl.type_rule: Caption only (7.5pt / 8pt). No headlines on envelopes.

layout_rules.logo_zone: col 1, row 1 (top-left, small — Caption size only)
layout_rules.rule: Large bottom margin is correct — address concentrates in upper third.

envelope_dl.notes: Bottom 178px = blank zone below address (standard envelope layout). Large bottom margin is intentional.

envelope_c5_landscape.name: Envelope C5 Landscape
envelope_c5_landscape.type_rule: Caption only. Address in cols 2-3, rows 1-2.

layout_rules.rule: Content concentrates in upper two-thirds. Row 3 = sender footer or blank.

envelope_c5_landscape.notes: Larger bottom margin reflects C5 format — content in upper two-thirds.

envelope_c4_landscape.name: Envelope C4 Landscape
envelope_c4_landscape.type_rule: Caption only. Address in cols 2-4, rows 2-3.

layout_rules.rule: C4 holds unfolded A4. Address zone mirrors A4 letterhead address position.

envelope_c4_landscape.notes: C4 holds unfolded A4 documents. Logo zone col 1 row 1.

event_ticket.name: Event Ticket
event_ticket.type_rule: H3 (event name), Caption (date/time/venue). No body text.

layout_rules.event_zone: cols 1-3, rows 1-2 (H3 event name + caption details)
layout_rules.perforation: Vertical dashed line between col 3 and col 4
layout_rules.rule: Cols 1-3 = main body. Col 4 = tear-off stub. Perforation between.

event_ticket.notes: @1x. Export at actual size (190×75mm at 300dpi = 2244×886px). Draw tear-off perforation line at col 3 right edge.

table_tent_card.name: Table Tent Card

layout_rules.rule: Build as 2 frames stacked. Top frame = front. Bottom frame = back (inverted).

table_tent_card.notes: Real tent card has front and back. Build 2 frames. Bottom frame content inverts vertically for fold-behind display.

sticky_note.name: Sticky Note
sticky_note.type_rule: Body (writing lines), Caption (brand mark bottom-right only).

layout_rules.brand_zone: col 2, row 3 (small logo stamp — Caption size only)
layout_rules.rule: Brand appears once as a small stamp. Nothing else. The note is for writing.

sticky_note.notes: Grid is deliberately minimal. Brand appears only as small logo in col 2 row 3.

name_badge_lanyard.name: Name Badge / Lanyard Card

layout_rules.rule: Large top/bottom margins are intentional — they create the professional white space. Never crowd the margins.

name_badge_lanyard.notes: @2x — export @0.5x for print. Large margins (94px) create the white space essential to badge quality.

rollup_banner_scale.name: Roll-up Banner @1:10 scale
rollup_banner_scale.scale_note: 1:10 — every mm in Figma = 10mm real. Export at 10× scale for print.

layout_rules.headline_zone: cols 1-3, rows 2-3 (Display at real-world 85pt = 8.5pt in Figma)
layout_rules.rule: Logo top. Headline immediately below. Image fills centre. CTA bottom. Classic roll-up hierarchy.

rollup_banner_scale.notes: CRITICAL: Type sizes are 10× SMALLER than intended display. Display at 85px real = 8.5px in Figma frame. Use minimum 6pt for smallest text.

packaging_label_70x35.name: Packaging Label 70×35mm

layout_rules.product_zone: cols 1-2, rows 1-2 (H3 product name + Caption description)
layout_rules.barcode_zone: col 3, rows 1-2 (barcode — reserved, do not place text)
layout_rules.rule: Cols 1-2 = product identity. Col 3 = barcode zone only. Never mix.

packaging_label_70x35.notes: @2x — export @0.5x for print. Col 3 is reserved for barcode/QR code exclusively.

hang_tag_price_tag.name: Hang Tag / Price Tag
hang_tag_price_tag.type_rule: Overline (category), H2 (product name), H3 (variant), Body (price), Caption (SKU/barcode).

layout_rules.hole_zone: top 46px margin (hole punch — 4mm diameter guide at top-centre)
layout_rules.price_zone: cols 1-2, row 6 (Body: price — can use weight 700 here)
layout_rules.rule: Strict top-to-bottom hierarchy. Price is the one permitted use of weight 700.

hang_tag_price_tag.notes: @2x — export @0.5x. Hole punch guide = 4mm diameter circle at top-centre of 46px margin.

facebook_post.name: Facebook Post / LinkedIn Post / Open Graph
facebook_post.type_rule: H2 + Caption only. Never Body (16px) — too small at social scale.

layout_rules.logo_zone: Always col 4, row 3 (bottom-right) OR col 1, row 1 (top-left)
layout_rules.rule: H2 must be readable as thumbnail (120×63px). Single clear message.

facebook_post.notes: LinkedIn Post = identical 1200×628. Open Graph = 1200×630 (adjust margin_b to 76). Build one, inherit two.

facebook_cover.name: Facebook Cover
facebook_cover.type_rule: Display + Overline only. Pure brand presence. No body text.

layout_rules.brand_zone: cols 3-4, rows 1-2 (primary brand — away from profile photo)
layout_rules.image_zone: cols 1-4, rows 1-2 (full bleed brand image or colour)
layout_rules.safe_zone: cols 3-4 only — profile photo overlaps cols 1-2, row 2
layout_rules.rule: CRITICAL: Facebook overlays profile photo bottom-left. Cols 1-2 row 2 must be clear of critical content.

facebook_cover.notes: Profile photo safe zone: avoid cols 1-2 rows 1-2 for critical content.

safe_zone.note: Cols 3-4 only are guaranteed safe. Keep logo and text here.

facebook_event_banner.name: Facebook Event Banner / Zoom Background
facebook_event_banner.type_rule: H1 + H2 + Caption. No body text.

layout_rules.safe_zone: cols 2-5 (avoid cols 1 and 6 — may be cropped on some displays)
layout_rules.image_zone: cols 1-3 rows 1-5 OR cols 4-6 rows 1-5 (split layout)
layout_rules.rule: For Zoom/Teams: safe zone = cols 2-5. Face typically occupies left third on video calls.

facebook_event_banner.notes: For Zoom/Teams: avoid cols 1 and 6 for critical content (cropped or obscured by face on video).

linkedin_personal_banner.name: LinkedIn Personal Banner
linkedin_personal_banner.type_rule: Overline + H2. One line each. Nothing more.

layout_rules.safe_zone: cols 3-6 — profile photo obscures cols 1-2 bottom-left
layout_rules.rule: Start meaningful content from col 3. Cols 1-2 are partially obscured by profile photo.

safe_zone.note: Profile photo overlaps bottom-left. Cols 1-2 partially obscured. Start content from col 3.

linkedin_company_banner.name: LinkedIn Company Banner
linkedin_company_banner.type_rule: Overline + Caption. Extreme horizontal constraint — minimal type only.

layout_rules.rule: One row only. Logo left. Tagline centre. URL right. Nothing else.

linkedin_company_banner.notes: Barely taller than a single field. Extreme constraint forces clarity.

twitter_x_post.name: Twitter/X Post
twitter_x_post.type_rule: H2 + Caption. Twitter is fast media — type must read in under 2 seconds.

layout_rules.rule: Single clear message. 8 words maximum for headline. Brand bottom-right.

twitter_x_header.name: Twitter/X Header
twitter_x_header.type_rule: Display + Overline. Brand only, no body copy.

layout_rules.brand_zone: cols 2-4, rows 1-3 (away from profile photo zone)
layout_rules.rule: Keep col 1 clear below row 1 — Twitter overlaps profile photo bottom-left.

twitter_x_header.notes: Profile photo overlaps col 1 below row 1. Keep col 2+ for critical content.

pinterest_pin.name: Pinterest Pin
pinterest_pin.type_rule: H1 + H2 + Body. Pinterest is long-scroll — full type scale applies.

layout_rules.image_zone: cols 1-4, rows 1-6 (large image — minimum 60% of frame)
layout_rules.rule: Image dominates top. Text zone bottom. CTA always last row.

pinterest_pin.notes: Most vertical format in the system. Image zone rows 1-6. Text zone rows 7-10.

youtube_thumbnail.name: YouTube Thumbnail
youtube_thumbnail.type_rule: H1 only (max 3 words). Display at large scale if text-led.

layout_rules.number_zone: cols 3-4, rows 1-2 (large numeral if list-style thumbnail)
layout_rules.rule: Must read at 120×68px (thumbnail size). Max 3 words. One weight-700 accent permitted.

youtube_thumbnail.notes: Cluster F (presentation scale). Use weight 700 for single key word — this is the one permitted use per composition. Text right, face left.

youtube_channel_art.name: YouTube Channel Art
youtube_channel_art.type_rule: Display + Overline in safe zone only.

layout_rules.safe_zone: cols 2-5, rows 2-3 (centre 1546×423px — visible on all devices)
layout_rules.tv_zone: cols 1-6, rows 1-5 (full frame — visible on TV only)
layout_rules.brand_zone: col 3, row 2 (Display — centred in safe zone)
layout_rules.rule: CRITICAL: Safe zone = centre 1546×423px. ALL text and logo must fit inside. Outside = TV only.

youtube_channel_art.notes: YouTube displays at different sizes on different devices. SAFE ZONE IS NON-NEGOTIABLE.

safe_zone.note: Centre 1546×423px — visible on all devices (TV, desktop, mobile, tablet)

whatsapp_business_profile.name: WhatsApp Business Profile
whatsapp_business_profile.type_rule: Logo/mark only for profile photo. No text — displays at 54px on screen.

layout_rules.rule: Profile photo displays as circle. All content within cols 2-3 rows 2-3 only.

safe_zone.note: Corners of frame are cropped. Keep all content within cols 2-3, rows 2-3.

layout_rules.safe_zone: cols 2-3 (centre 60% — mobile may crop cols 1 and 4)
layout_rules.rule: Safe zone = centre 60%. Logo and primary text: cols 2-3. Cols 1 and 4 may be cropped on mobile.

newsletter_template.name: Email Newsletter Template
newsletter_template.type_rule: H2 + Body + Caption. Standard email type scale.

layout_rules.header_zone: cols 1-4, rows 1-2 (hero image or primary colour band)
layout_rules.body_zone: cols 1-3, rows 4-5 (Body text — max 2 cols for readability)
layout_rules.rule: Build as stacking section frames. Max 6 content sections + 1 hero + 1 footer.

newsletter_template.notes: Variable height. Base frame = 984px (8 content modules). Build as stacking section frames: hero (216px) + content blocks (96px) + dividers (24px) + footer (96px). Total height varies per issue.

app_icon.name: App Icon

layout_rules.mark_zone: FI monogram at Inter 300 — sized to fit iOS safe zone
layout_rules.rule: No text. No background that conflicts with system chrome. Mark must read at 29×29px (smallest iOS display size).

app_icon.notes: Export: 1024×1024px PNG (iOS). Adaptive icon with foreground layer for Android. Mark must be legible at 29×29px minimum.

open_graph.name: Open Graph / Link Preview
open_graph.type_rule: H2 + Caption (URL). Reads as thumbnail in link previews.

layout_rules.headline_zone: cols 1-3, rows 1-2 (H2 — page title in Warm White)
layout_rules.logo_zone: col 4, rows 1-3 (right edge — logo in Warm White)
layout_rules.rule: Build for every key page. Primary background. Warm White text. Single clear page title.

open_graph.notes: Build variants for: Home, About, Services, Blog, Contact. Each has different H2 headline.

website_hero.name: Website Hero

layout_rules.image_zone: cols 3-4, rows 1-5 (right column — brand image or demo)
layout_rules.rule: Wider margins (80px) = web breathing room. Content max-width 1280px. Navigation above grid.

website_hero.notes: Navigation sits above the grid in the 52px top margin zone. Content max-width = 1280px (cols 1-4 between margins).

a4_second_page.name: A4 Second Page
a4_second_page.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.
a4_second_page.notes: No logo zone. Pure type area. Continuation of letterhead.

layout_rules.rule: No header or footer repeat. Content only.

invoice_template.name: Invoice Template
invoice_template.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.
invoice_template.notes: Col 4 = price column (right-aligned figures). Rows 1 = header, rows 2-4 = line items, row 5 = totals.

layout_rules.header_zone: cols 1-4, row 1 (invoice details: number, date, due)
layout_rules.rule: Col 4 is exclusively the price/number column. Align all figures right.

quote_proposal.name: Quote / Proposal Template
quote_proposal.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: Same grid as invoice. Cols 1-3 = description/scope, col 4 = price. Row 1 = header, rows 2-4 = scope items, row 5 = total + validity.

contract_cover.name: Contract Cover Page
contract_cover.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: Row 1 = logo + date, rows 2-3 = contract title (H1), row 4 = party names, row 5 = signature blocks.

delivery_note.name: Delivery Note
delivery_note.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: Row 1 = header. Rows 2-4 = item list (col 4 = quantity). Row 5 = confirmation/signature.

purchase_order.name: Purchase Order
purchase_order.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: Same as invoice. PO number prominent in header. Cols 1-3 = items, col 4 = unit price.

folder_cover.name: Folder / Document Wallet Cover
folder_cover.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: More spacious than letterhead. Treat as a mini poster.

notepad.name: Notepad / Writing Pad
notepad.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: Header row 1 only. Rest = ruled writing lines at 19px (Cluster A line height).

notepad.special: Add ruled lines at 19px intervals (1 line height) within the body zone.

a4_flyer_single.name: A4 Flyer Single Sided
a4_flyer_single.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: Same grid. Different content priority — hero over utility.

a4_flyer_double.name: A4 Flyer Double Sided
a4_flyer_double.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.
a4_flyer_double.notes: Two separate frames at 595×842px. Front and back. Same grid applied to both.

layout_rules.rule: Front = brand-forward. Back = detail/information. Same grid, different emphasis.

a5_brochure_folded.name: A5 Brochure Folded
a5_brochure_folded.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A5 Flyer'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: Two frames (front/back). Same grid. Front = headline + image. Back = details + contact.

drinks_menu.name: Drinks Menu
drinks_menu.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A5 Flyer'. No recalculation needed.
drinks_menu.notes: Col 4 = price column (right-aligned). Two A5 frames = front (drinks list) + back (food/cocktails).

layout_rules.rule: Col 4 = price column. Cols 1-3 = item name + description. Row 1 = category header. Rows 2-4 = items. Row 5 = footer.

loyalty_card.name: Loyalty Card
loyalty_card.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'Business Card @2x'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.stamp_zone: cols 1-4, rows 2-3 (stamp boxes — equal size squares)
layout_rules.rule: Stamp boxes = primary element. Logo small top-left. URL bottom-right Caption.

staff_id_card.name: Staff ID Card
staff_id_card.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'Business Card @2x'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: Photo left. Identity right. Always photo on ID cards.

qr_code_card.name: QR Code Card
qr_code_card.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'Business Card @2x'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.qr_zone: cols 3-4, rows 1-3 (QR code — square, fills cols 3-4)
layout_rules.rule: QR code = cols 3-4 full height. Brand info = cols 1-2.

digital_business_card.name: Digital Business Card
digital_business_card.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'Business Card @2x'. No recalculation needed.
digital_business_card.notes: Digital version — may include NFC/tap-to-share info. Col 3-4 = QR code zone.

layout_rules.rule: Same as physical card. Add QR code in cols 3-4 rows 2-3 pointing to digital profile.

gift_voucher_dl.name: Gift Voucher DL
gift_voucher_dl.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'Compliments Slip DL'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.code_zone: cols 1-4, row 2 (Caption: voucher code + expiry — centred)
layout_rules.rule: Value dominates. Code centred below. Treat as a mini ticket.

email_header_banner.name: Email Header / Banner
email_header_banner.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'Email Signature'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: Full-width brand header for email templates. Logo left. Tagline centred. URL right.

email_footer.name: Email Footer
email_footer.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'Email Signature'. No recalculation needed.
email_footer.notes: Crop to top 1 row only (80px). Caption text: unsubscribe, legal, address.

layout_rules.rule: Single row. Caption only: unsubscribe link | legal | address. No logo.

instagram_carousel.name: Instagram Carousel
instagram_carousel.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'Instagram Post'. No recalculation needed.
instagram_carousel.notes: Multi-frame. First frame = cover. Frames 2-9 = content slides. Last frame = CTA.

layout_rules.rule: Consistent grid across all frames. Same visual anchor (logo position) on every slide. Content varies.

instagram_highlight_cover.name: Instagram Highlight Cover
instagram_highlight_cover.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'Instagram Post'. No recalculation needed.
instagram_highlight_cover.notes: Displays as circle crop at 161×161px. Keep all content within centre 60% (648×648px).

layout_rules.rule: Content within cols 2-3, rows 2-3 only (circle-safe zone). Icon or single word maximum.

linkedin_post.name: LinkedIn Post
linkedin_post.inherits_from: Facebook Post / LinkedIn Post / Open Graph
linkedin_post.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'Facebook Post / LinkedIn Post / Open Graph'. No recalculation needed.
linkedin_post.notes: Identical to Facebook Post. Same grid style. Different content tone.

layout_rules.rule: Identical to Facebook Post. Cols 1-3 = content, col 4 = brand. H2 + Caption. Professional tone — remove urgency language used on Facebook.

tiktok_thumbnail.name: TikTok Thumbnail
tiktok_thumbnail.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'Instagram Story'. No recalculation needed.
tiktok_thumbnail.notes: Same frame and grid as Instagram Story. TikTok thumbnail = 9:16 ratio, identical dimensions.

layout_rules.rule: Logo top. Large text centre. CTA bottom. High contrast — reads on small mobile screens.

zoom_teams_background.name: Zoom / Teams Virtual Background
zoom_teams_background.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'Pitch Deck'. No recalculation needed.
zoom_teams_background.notes: Same grid as Pitch Deck. Critical difference: face appears in left third on video calls.

layout_rules.rule: Keep cols 3-6 for all meaningful content. Cols 1-2 will be partially obscured by participant's face.

logo_lockup_sheet.name: Logo Lockup Sheet
logo_lockup_sheet.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: A4 grid. Brand documentation format. Overline category label. Content fills rows 2-5.

typography_specimen.name: Typography Specimen
typography_specimen.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: A4 grid. Brand documentation format. Overline category label. Content fills rows 2-5.

typeface_pairing_guide.name: Typeface Pairing Guide
typeface_pairing_guide.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: A4 grid. Brand documentation format. Overline category label. Content fills rows 2-5.

colour_usage_sheets.name: Colour Usage Sheets
colour_usage_sheets.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: A4 grid. Brand documentation format. Overline category label. Content fills rows 2-5.

cmyk_rgb_hex_sheet.name: CMYK / RGB / HEX Values Sheet
cmyk_rgb_hex_sheet.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: A4 grid. Brand documentation format. Overline category label. Content fills rows 2-5.

photography_style_guide.name: Photography Style Guide
photography_style_guide.grid_note: Apply identical grid style to 'A4 Letterhead'. No recalculation needed.

layout_rules.rule: A4 grid. Brand documentation format. Overline category label. Content fills rows 2-5.

immutable: Never use pure black #000000 or pure white #FFFFFF
Never use a colour outside the brand specification
Never use a type size outside the 7-level scale
Never use weight 700 more than once per composition
Every spacing value must be a multiple of 8px
Every text element must use a named text style
Every colour must use a named colour style
All content stays within margin boundaries
Accent colour: one use per composition (Bezold Rule)
When in doubt — use less. Restraint is always correct.

typographic.weight_700: Permitted exactly once per composition as an inline accent. Never on headings.
typographic.overline: Always uppercase with tracking +0.12em. Directs attention toward headline. Never competes.
typographic.serif_H3: Uses italic, not weight 500. The italic is structurally distinct.

colour.primary: One primary colour per brand. Derived from Brand Type scoring.
colour.accent: Derived algorithmically — 120° HSL rotation, Albers-corrected. One use per composition.
colour.neutrals: Fixed stack. Every Form Identity brand receives the same five neutrals.

rules.bezold: A second accent colour transforms every other colour in the composition. Use sparingly.

muller_brockmann.formula: Column gutter = body type size. Row gutter = 1 × line height. Field height = N × line height (whole number). Margins = whatever remains after the arithmetic is exact.
muller_brockmann.principle: Type precedes grid. Body size determines line height. Line height determines everything else.
